a: अभुंजत् — a. 1 Not eating. --2 Not allowing to enjoy. --3 Not protecting.

m: अ-भुञ्जान mfn. not eating, fasting, R.; Gaut.
अ-भुञ्जत् mfn. not being useful to, not liberal, stingy, RV. i, 120, 12 and viii, 1, 6

a: अभुग्न — a. 1 Not bent or crooked, straight. --2 Well, free from disease.

m: अ-भुग्न-कुक्षिता f. the having the loins not bent (one of the 80 minor marks of a Buddha), Dharmas. 84.

v: tri॰ na BuNkte Buja--kvip na॰ ta॰ । aBakzake । “nama ASfRoH kimaBugvadAmi” f॰ 10, 95, 11 ।
m: अ-भुज् mfn. one who has not experienced or enjoyed, RV. x, 95, 11.
a: अभुज् — a. Ved. One who has not experienced or enjoyed; one who does not keep a promise.

m: अ-भुजंग-वत् mfn. without snakes (and ‘withont libertines’), Kāvyād. ii, 322.

a: अभुजिष्या — Not a slave or servant, an independent woman; Mk. 4.

m: अभुजिष्या-त्व n. the state of a woman who lives independently, Mṛcch. (cf. अ-भौजिष्य.)
अ-भुजिष्य m. f. not liberal, stingy, ŚāṅkhŚr.

s: tri, (Buj + BAve ktaH arSa Adyac vidyamAnArTe, naYsamAsaH, vA Buja + karmmaRi ktaH, naYsamAsaH .) upavAsI । yaTA, -- “aBuktasya divAnidrA pAzARamapi jIryyati” । iti vEdyakaM ॥ akftaBojanaM vastu ॥ (BuktA brAhmaRAH pItA gAva iti pARiniBAzyam । ‘nABuktaM kzIyate karmma kalpakowiSatErapi’ । iti purARam .)
v: tri॰ Buja--karmmaRi kta na॰ ta॰ । 1 “aBakzite annAdO 2 akftaBoge puRyAdO ca । “nABuktaM kzIyate karmma kalpakowiSatErapi” purA॰ । BogaSca BojanIyadravyAhAraH karmmakftasuKaduH svAnuBavaSca ॥ BuktaM BojanaM BAve kta arSA॰ ac na॰ ta॰ । 3 BuktavadBinne “BuktAbrAhmaRAH pItA gAva iti arSa Adyaca” pA॰ BAzyam । mugDaboDe tu karttari kta ityuktam । “aBuktO hyatiTirvrajan” smftiH “aBuktasya divA nidrA pAzARamapi jIryyati” vEdya॰ ।
m: one who has not eaten, enjoyed or expended.
a: अभुक्त — a. 1 Uneaten, unenjoyed, unused; Bh. 3. 25. --2 (Actively used) One who has not eaten, enjoyed, used &c.; cf. पीत. --Comp. --मूलं the interval between the closing part of Jyeṣṭhā and the beginning of Mūla.

v: na॰ “BujaNgapOrandarapOzRaBAnAM tadagraBAnAYca yadantarAlam । aBuktamUlaM praharapramARaM tyajet sutaM tatraBavAM sutAYca” iti nAra॰ । “jyezWAnte Gawike dDe ca mUlAdya GawikAdvayam । aBuktamUlamityAhurjjAtaM tatra vivarjjayet” vaSi॰ jyezWAntyaGawikArdDaYca mUlAdO GawikArdDakam । tayorantargatA nAqI hyaBuktamUlamucyate” iti vfha॰ pa॰ ukte jyezWAmUlAnakzatrayorAdyantaGawikAviSeze ।

m: अ-भुक्त—पूर्व mfn. what has not been enjoyed before, MBh. xii, 180, 32.
अ-भुक्त—वत् mfn. one who has not eaten, MBh.; Suśr.
अ-भुव n. (√ भू), ‘no real or common being’, a monster, MaitrS. (cf. अ-भ्व.)
